instruct: Castilian Spanish accent from Spain (c and z pronounced as 'th'), natural and human, never robotic. Male narrator in his twenties, a popular YouTube storyteller for teenagers. Clear, energetic but relaxed, friendly and a bit playful, medium-low pitch.

lineas.texto: Imagina que esta noche te duermes… y te despiertas en el año mil trescientos.
Sin móvil. Sin luz. Y con un gallo gritándote en la oreja antes de que salga el sol.
